story.title: MCADAMS TAPS INDUSTRY VETERAN MARILYN RAMIREZ TO LEAD GROWTH OF ITS ENERGY PRACTICE NATIONWIDE
story.summary: LEWISVILLE, TEXAS (November 23, 2026) – McAdams, a multidisciplinary planning, design and engineering firm, announced today the appointment of Marilyn Ramirez LEWISVILLE, TEXAS (November 23, 2026) – McAdams, a multidisciplinary planning, design and engineering firm, announced today the appointment of Marilyn Ramirez as vice president of Energy + Power. Ramirez will lead the firm’s energy growth strategy across its markets nationwide, with a focus on expanding power delivery capabilities amid rising demand for utility infrastructure. McAdams’ work for energy clients spans nearly two decades and includes site development for substations and switchyards, operations centers, training facilities, transmission and distribution grids, and solar and renewable energy work.
